Alexandria / Mohamed Gaber and Julieta Ulanovsky
Official source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/alexandria
Upstream: https://github.com/Gue3bara/Alexandria
Variable wght axis 100–900. WOFF2 converted losslessly from the supplied variable TTF using fontTools.
SIL Open Font License 1.1 is included in Alexandria-OFL.txt.
